Now that I'm awake, that must mean that a
vaccine has been developed.
I woke up to a future that I could never even dream of.
But――
The world changed a lot in these 30 years.
The country I lived in isn't around anymore.

The world wobbles precariously between whether
to embrace a society of ideals or a society of competition.
Sheesh.

…yep.
But, I'm tired.
I think I've done well so far, but I'm a little tired.
…ahh, I'm a mess.
Something soundless rouses my consciousness.

Word is you're famous.
The elders gave me firm orders to make
a proper magus out of you.
He extends an unfamiliar, rough hand to me.

An unfamiliar sense of nostalgia washes over me,
blurring my sight.

…
Sorry, but have we ever met before?

I must've had a really weird look on my face.
The young man looks at me, puzzled.
I reply, "no, it's nothing."
I don't know why, but I think I was gently smiling at him.

so we decided to move away from the
#C000246204SE.RA.PH#CDEF's center and live in this backcountry.

Likewise.

―――I felt so happy that I closed my eyes,

The legend of the Moon may have ended,
but our legend continues.
Reflecting on that, I slowly open my eyes.

A moment ago, the #C000246204SE.RA.PH#CDEF was

Presently, normal operating areas have shrunk by
3%. The capital has been overwritten with a 2D

Outside our apartment, everything is turning

#C236196003Caster#CDEF.
Why did the name "#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF" come up just now?
……………teehee?

Hahahahahahahahahahahahahaha! From morning to

#C000246204SE.RA.PH#CDEF―hear me and tremble!

One, two,

Ulp… The fox is out of the bag…
Ever the keen detective, Darling…
No―――don't tell me―――

No, even #C236196003Caster#CDEF wouldn't do something so terrible.
She's a responsible woman.
A proper adult that can tame the darkness in her
heart… right!?
She's worse than #C236196003BB#CDEF…!
You numbskull! You absolute dimwit!

And look, they're just palette swaps!
That's plain, flat-out lazy!
The #C000246204SE.RA.PH#CDEF got taken over by THEM!?

#C236196003Caster#CDEF starts to bawl.
Maybe she's feeling responsible now.

Ultimately, I'm the reason this all happened.
The #C000246204SE.RA.PH#CDEF's populace may blame #C236196003Caster#CDEF,
but #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF is the one person who can't.
That's why I need to clean up this mess myself.
I begrudgingly reply, "guess I have to."

Kya☆
This is why I LOVE my Darling!
…however.

Hey, Darling?
You don't hate me?
Despite everything that happened?

Huh? You're "used to it"?
You say we're fighting for my sake this time?
And you want a new outfit?

And. Yet.

Wait, first I want an explanation…!
Where are we, what happened!?
And why are you half-naked, man!?

The #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF cannot allow you to be.

Don't "lo" me.

Please, contain your glee. You'll make me blush.
Would you have preferred the alternative?
To quietly return to nothingness?
Still―――I feel like I'm being too greedy―――

I'm about to go on a journey with this

A high temperature circulates throughout my body.
It's like something triggered and started a domino effect.

#C080080080I squint under the strong sunlight.
Looks like today's going to be another scorcher.#CDEF

The smell of the earth. The far-off hustle and bustle.
The feel of the wind. The sound of a jeep.

I can hear the trainees shouting off in the distance.
They must have them running a marathon to gauge their stamina.

I slip away to sit under the shade of a tree
so I can skip… erm, take a break from training.

I know I'm really shifting gears here,
but my name is #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.

I only just woke up a while ago.
I've come from thirty years in the past.

I was infected with a virus that broke out
in the twentieth century.
Basically, I was in a deep sleep
until they could invent a cure.

The name of the disease I had was "Amnesia Syndrome":
a condition where the memory portions of the
brain get overwritten.
Once you're infected, you start to lose your memory day by day.

Although they apparently found a cure, my memory is still hazy.
I don't know if it's an after-effect
or if I didn't get the cure in time.

Yep. I kind of get the feeling that somewhere in the
depths of my mind, there's a me quipping "not again!"

But hey, I'm truly fortunate to be awake again.
I'm grateful to be able to fill my lungs
with fresh air like this again.

They say a disaster caused its social system to collapse.
The cities fell apart, and the people scattered across
the world.

And that's how a certain island nation came to
take a long leave of absence.
West European countries then stepped up to become
the largest world powers, completely controlling
all resources and putting the progression of human
technology on hold.

After I underwent cryopreservation,
the two biggest countries of the world―
with their large populations and fondness for mass production―
ultimately fell together.

The West European countries managed to domineer
60 percent of Earth's resources in the blink of an eye.
They're pushing to establish a society
controlled by a ruling class.
Naturally, this system of government
is run by Caucasians.

On the other hand, although countries of the
Middle East can't manage to unify,
they oppose the ideologies of West Europe.
They continue to skirmish against them over
all corners of the world even now.

In the midst of all this,
I awoke in the ruins of my home country.
After undertaking an adventure beyond words,
I left my island nation and went overseas.
I was pursued by a West European conglomerate
(for some reason, I was on their wanted list!)
but escaped. Now, I'm under care in a
refugee camp in the Middle East.

Even if you're not a mercenary or a soldier,
in this day and age there's a minimum level of skills
you need to have if you want to survive.

That's why I joined an organization that
volunteers by giving these kinds of lectures
and took some training from them.

I was just a high school student from an age of peace.
After surviving this long, I think I deserve a little applause.

I woke up to find the family always by my side,
the friends I was close to―all gone.
My town is unrecognizable; nothing but sprawling ruins.

Also, it seems like I was the only person
who woke up from their cold sleep.

People dear to me entrusted me with the future.
The pride of those nameless people who never made it
to the future is at stake.
So I don't want to just give up.
That singular purpose drove me this far.

…but, I really wish the universe would start going easy on me.
Abandoning one's past self to embrace a new era is hard.
Plain and simple.

All these thoughts popped into my head
during my 10 kilometer marathon.
My legs started giving out, so I went for some
cool shade and ended up sitting down.

The sunlight is strong today.
I put my towel over my head, look down, and take a deep breath.

My motto up until now was "at least don't complain."
But I think I've straight up run out of gas.

You looking at me, God?
As you can see, this is as far as I can go on my own.

I guess all of these pent up thoughts
gushed out of me because I had myself a sit-down.

…I really am at the end of my rope.
For whatever reason, I murmur to myself that
I may never stand up again―――

What's the matter?
Too long of a break will end up hindering you.
―――I squint under the strong sunlight.
The blue sky makes an impact on me.

Ahh, sorry.
As of today, I'm the appointed
combat instructor here.

You're #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF, right? I've been
hired to look after you. I'm sure you have
reservations, but please understand.

So, for the next half a year, there will be no
pretense between us. I work for my pay.
The rest depends on your effort and guts.

…hey, you're dehydrated bad.
Can you stand? I'll give you a hand
if it's too hard to do on your own.

―――I remember something from my long sleep.
I had a dream about someone with the same name and soul as me.

Okay. Then let me introduce myself again. Having
you call me "instructor" doesn't sit right with
me, so from now on, call me by my name.

Pleasure to meet you, #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.
My name is―――
#C080080080―――I grab his outstretched hand.#CDEF

#C080080080―――I had collapsed from all my whining,
but new blood now flows through me.#CDEF

#C080080080―――A sentiment from someone other than
      myself flickers in me:
      "thanks for staying until the end."#CDEF

#C080080080…once, I had lost many things.
         Many events had faded into the past.#CDEF

#C080080080I don't know if any reward in this
world is worth the loss of so much.#CDEF

#C080080080I, "#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF#C080080080," anywhere or anytime,
am nothing more than one, insignificant person.#CDEF

Even if I've lost my ability to fight,
my heart can summon it all back at any time.#CDEF

――――Well.
That's what SHOULD'VE happened, anyway.

Yes, a time barrier is nothing to me!
Call and I'll be there posthaste!
Not that I was actually called here, though鷙

However! Though the world may accept your
sacrifice to bring peace to the Earth,
the gods will not!

If I am stolen from, I steal back. If I receive
pushback, I push until I win. If it's against
the rules, then I change the rules―――

That's the spirit of someone in love!
Those who would impede me, beware!
You'll get a #RUBSSolar Flare Kick#RUBEFlare Skirt#REND to the face!
#C080080080…she's really done it this time.#CDEF
#C080080080Her sunny smile could smooth over just about anything.#CDEF

#C080080080And thus, with a single embrace,
#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF#C080080080's fate―which was supposed
to have decidedly ended―fades into the seaweeds
of the lunar ocean.#CDEF
I open up and stuff my face with #C236196003Caster#CDEF's cooking.

I silently nod in approval of the taste.
Each time I do, #C236196003Caster#CDEF's ears perk up,
and a broad smile washes over her face.
It almost scares me how naturally I've adjusted to it.

But hey, I'm happy, so plenty of things don't bother me
anymore.

Heehee. I made the right choice moving us here.
Away from the clamor of the city,
we can spend our days in peace…

Not even light speed delivery reaches this back-
country apartment at the #C000246204SE.RA.PH#CDEF's edge, but
I'm happy. It's nice, despite being four-mat.

#C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF was fated to stop the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF's
operations and then be disassembled in the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF.

But #C236196003Caster#CDEF stopped that from happening
through her determination… or rather, her kick.

Specifically, I sort of Tamamo-kicked my
way into that stubborn #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF. After all,
the #RUBS  older sister#RUBESun#REND is never outshined by#RUBS    little brother#RUBE the Moon#REND鷙

#RUBS    Manifestation of a Woman's Power, Akin to a Solar Flare#RUBE          Flare Skirt Bunker Buster#REND
is that spin kick's official name.
It dominates against underground structures…

I don't know if that was the best option,
but #C236196003Caster#CDEF busted her way into the #C000246204Moon Cell's Core#CDEF
by force and saved #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.

In the end, the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF didn't completely stop functioning,
but the way it works changed.
It serves its new function best for humanity
by being a new frontier for exploration.

A new group of Masters arrived in the #C000246204SE.RA.PH#CDEF's center
and are in the process of forming a new organization.
They're making substantial progress.

I have no way of returning to Earth,
so this imaginary Spiritron world is my new home.
My main focus right now is on living here in peace.

Gosh. You never want anything. We're in a great
position to seize political power. Wealth,
riches, and influence as we want―and still.

But I love that unselfish side of you鷙 Okay,
say "ahh"鷙 My Tamamo pickles're more important
than any of that stuff, aren't they～!

…well, to be honest, I would turn into a real
witch if I had those three things. My feeling
is, let those little humans have them.

I always end up being the ruinous beauty in any
country I'm in. I just need to be devoted to
something. Being with you makes me happy鷙

Technically, I'm not even supposed to be alive right now.
But she protected me, cared for me,
and even made an enemy out of #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF to save me.
…I didn't find out what my wish was until the very end.
After many battles, it seems I finally found out what it is.

Everything I desire lies spread across the future.
    Now, nothing is missing from this dream―――

―――It's time for the news. Early this
morning, yet again the mysterious hex-garbed
group―"Nine"―has begun wreaking havoc.

The hex-garb group insist they "will protect
Darling," and will continue until "they find
the traitor and bring her to her knees"―――

We have additional breaking news:
a notice from the new government.

Oh, my. What could that be? These organizations
have taken quite the disturbing turn.
Anyway, Darling, here―say "ahh"鷙
Hey, #C236196003Caster#CDEF! We should be panicking!

We have a new report:
a statement has arrived from the group
believed to be the criminals responsible.

"This is to the traitor #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.
 This world belongs to me now. If you wish to do
 something about it, then come to my castle."

"Do so quickly. There will be no delays. If you
 don't come, this world is going to look like
 an RPG Maker game of national renown!"

…hold up.
Let's just say that the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF is in trouble
and leave it at that for now.

I feel dizzy. I'm about to faint.
I have no clue what's going on,
but there's one thing I can be sure about.
#C236196003Caster#CDEF is, without a doubt, the culprit here.

Ahh, they're even stealing our resources―――
All Masters, please remain orderly and―

Each nation has its own principles, fetishes,
flaws, and advantages―but you lowly citizens
have no choice in the matter!

We hereby declare that every day shall be
a comical play, completely directed under
our control!

As for you, traitor; the original! Your just
deserts are on their way! Ah, prepare
yourself too, Darling. You're complicit鷙
――――――. (Mind is blank.)

Ohh, nooo, Darling! #C236196003Tamamo#CDEF is sooo scared鷙
I just have NO clue what I did, so why am
I getting aaaalllll this resentment?

…I reel back my swooning consciousness
and grab the root of all evil by her shoulders.
What did you do, you dumb fox!?

…honestly, umm.
So in order to bring you back here,
I needed to enter my nine-tailed state, see?

I leveled up a bunch, sped through strict sage
training then went into my nine-tailed form.
Thanks to that, I conquered the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF.

So that's what I did, but…
that's when I realized that there was a problem.
"What should I do with all these tails?"

However, it was too late. Once I reunited
with Darling, my various tails began
laying claims to "what was theirs by right."

I quietly severed each tail and threw them
into the Imaginary Number Space. Perhaps I
shouldn't have done that, though.

Now they've returned as bosses.
That's who those girls are―――They are known
as the "Alter Ego Tamamo Nine"!

Kya☆
Pleaaaasee don't get so mad at me鷙

D'oh. They grew up so fast―they even took over
the #C000246204Moon Cell#CDEF…! But they're my tails
after all, so they're positively insatiable!

…not much we can do about the past.
We're going to have to get out there
and quell this uprising ourselves.

#C236196003Caster#CDEF turned into the nine-tails she loathes
so much in order to save #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF.

! Darling, you've got a Master's glint
in your eyes! Could it be!?
You'll fight together with me!?

…I know I shouldn't be indulging her…
but I just can't say no to her.

Thus, together with #C236196003Caster#CDEF―the source of
all these evils―we embarked towards a new
battle to subdue the Tamamo Nine―――

Next time in episode one: the fearsome
brand-fanatic, Tamamo Gucci, takes the stage!
Don't miss―ouch!

You're the source of all the evils.
Please reflect on your actions.

To be honest, I'm feeling a bit excited myself.
I get to fight alongside her again.
And this time, we're going worldwide. Nine countries.
How could this NOT get my heart pumping?

We spent a brief, peaceful time here in this
apartment as #C236196003Caster#CDEF had wished to.
Now we're taking our leave.

Alright. Time to get this headache of a journey started.
We're up against eight #C236196003Casters#CDEF.
I'm looking forward to seeing what aspects of hers
I'll get to witness through them―――

…! Yes, leave it to me #RUBS  Master#RUBEDarling#REND!
I have yet to prove myself worthy,
but I'll follow you to the ends of the Earth!
